is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus group mosquitoes in Yaoundé, Cameroon.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for kdr alleles L1014F and L1014S in Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 4, 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 7 states: 'Of the 60 An. gambiae s.l. screened to detect the presence of the kdr allele, 49 were detected as carrying the west African kdr allele L1014F, whereas three were detected as carrying the east African kdr allele L1014S.'

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Yaoundé, Cameroon (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study conducted by the authors.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in the districts of Nsam and Mendong in Yaoundé, Cameroon (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted from April 2017 to March 2018 (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific, new collection period (2017-2018) in Yaoundé.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated malaria transmission and insecticide resistance in Anopheles mosquitoes in two districts of Yaoundé, Cameroon. It reports kdr genotyping (L1014F and L1014S) for 60 An. gambiae s.l. specimens.
